page.overview:
Who is Black King?

The Black King is the name of a statue of Westruun's founder Palest Westruun, mockingly named after the black dragon Umbrasyl, who briefly conquered Westruun during the Chroma Crisis. Both Westruun and the Black King statue were blessed by a High Priest of the Lawbearer when it was unveiled on the one-year anniversary of Westruun's freedom — when the city is threatened, the statue is supposed to animate into a stone golem and defend the people of Westruun.
